if_problem.statement_en: Prove that the limit $$\lim_{n \rightarrow \infty} \sin(n)$$ does not exist.
prerequisites: continuity and periodicity of trigonometric functions

callouts.id: 证明正弦函数在整数上取值的序列的极限是不存在的#2
callouts.title: 问题1.1
callouts.body: 证明$\sin(n)$是稠密的加强问题，证明$x_n=\sin(n)$这个序列形成的集合在子空间$[-1,1]$当中是稠密的。

classification_result.id: 证明正弦函数在整数上取值的序列的极限是不存在的#2

if_problem.statement_en: Prove the stronger statement that $\sin(n)$ is dense: namely, prove that the set formed by the sequence $x_n=\sin(n)$ is dense in the subspace $[-1,1]$.
key_techniques: continuous image of a dense set

callouts.id: 证明正弦函数在整数上取值的序列的极限是不存在的#3
callouts.title: 引理1.2
callouts.body: $X,Y$是两个拓扑空间，$f:X\to Y$是一个连续映射，$E$为$X$的一个稠密子集，那么$f(E)$是子空间$f(Y)$的一个稠密子集。

classification_result.id: 证明正弦函数在整数上取值的序列的极限是不存在的#3

if_problem.statement_en: Let $X,Y$ be topological spaces, let $f:X\to Y$ be a continuous map, and let $E$ be a dense subset of $X$. Then $f(E)$ is dense in the subspace $f(X)$.
key_techniques: continuity of images of dense sets

callouts.title: 问题1.3
callouts.body: 证明$\xi_n=n\text{ mod }2\pi$这个序列形成的集合$E$是区间$[0,2\pi]$当中的稠密子集。

classification_result.id: 证明正弦函数在整数上取值的序列的极限是不存在的#4

if_problem.statement_en: Prove that the set $E$ formed by the sequence $\xi_n=n\text{ mod }2\pi$ is dense in the interval $[0,2\pi]$.

callouts.id: 证明正弦函数在整数上取值的序列的极限是不存在的#5
callouts.title: 想法2.1.1
callouts.body: 参考[[柯西收敛判别#^9993bc]]，序列成为柯西列的一个必要条件是差分的绝对值$|a_{n+1}-a_n|$收敛到0。那么序列$\sin(n)$满足这一条吗？我们不妨假设它满足，看看这会发生什么。

classification_result.id: 证明正弦函数在整数上取值的序列的极限是不存在的#5

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Use the Cauchy Necessary Condition via Successive Differences
if_strategy_template.summary_en: To show a sequence does not converge, test a necessary condition for being Cauchy: if $a_n$ converges, then $|a_{n+1}-a_n| \to 0$. Assume this holds and derive a contradiction by computing or estimating the successive differences.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when a sequence has an explicit formula and the difference between consecutive terms is easy to analyze.

callouts.id: 证明正弦函数在整数上取值的序列的极限是不存在的#6
callouts.title: 想法2.2.1
callouts.body: 由于函数的周期性，我们只要能够在$\sin(x)$的值域$[-1,1]$当中分离出两个集合$A,B$然后保证$$d(A,B):=\inf\{|x-y|:x\in A,y\in B\}>0$$然后在每个周期内保证$A,B$对应的定义域中的集集合$I_{A,k},I_{B,k}$当中各自至少包含一个整数$n_k,m_k$那么我们就可以保证$$|\sin(n_k)-\sin(m_k)|\geq d(A,B)>0,\forall k\in \mathbb{Z}^{+}$$我们这里可以加强命题，只需要考虑如果$|I_{A,k}|,|I_{B,k}|\geq 1$，那么其中一定会包含整数。

classification_result.id: 证明正弦函数在整数上取值的序列的极限是不存在的#6

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Separate the Range into Two Positively Distanced Sets Across Periods
if_strategy_template.summary_en: Exploit periodicity by choosing two subsets $A,B$ of the range with positive mutual distance, then show that in each period there are integers landing in domain intervals mapped into $A$ and $B$. This yields two subsequences whose function values stay uniformly apart, preventing convergence.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies to nonconstant periodic functions sampled along integers or other discrete sets when each period contains sample points in separated regions of the graph.

callouts.id: 证明正弦函数在整数上取值的序列的极限是不存在的#7
callouts.title: 命题3.1.1
callouts.body: 设$f$是一个定义在实数上的,连续周期函数，其最小正周期为$T$。考虑序列$x_n:=f(n)$，并假设$x_n$并非常数序列那么该序列的极限不存在。

classification_result.id: 证明正弦函数在整数上取值的序列的极限是不存在的#7

if_problem.statement_en: Let $f$ be a continuous periodic function on $\mathbb{R}$ with least positive period $T$. Consider the sequence $x_n:=f(n)$. If $x_n$ is not a constant sequence, then the limit of $x_n$ does not exist.

callouts.title: 命题3.2.1
callouts.body:
下列序列的极限都不存在: 
$$x_n:=\sin(\sqrt{n}),z_n:=\sin(\log(n))$$

classification_result.id: 证明正弦函数在整数上取值的序列的极限是不存在的#8

if_problem.statement_en:
The following sequences do not have limits: 
$$x_n:=\sin(\sqrt{n}),z_n:=\sin(\log(n)).$$
prerequisites: properties of logarithm and square root

callouts.id: 证明正弦函数在整数上取值的序列的极限是不存在的#9
callouts.title: 命题3.2.2

classification_result.id: 证明正弦函数在整数上取值的序列的极限是不存在的#9

if_problem.statement_en: The sequence $\sin(2^n)$ does not have a limit.
